A0152.title: On-Chain Asset Ownership Verification and Traceability in the Metaverse
A0152.definition: Leveraging blockchain-based NFT technology to verify ownership of virtual assets and establish a traceable transaction history.
A0152.description: Blockchain-based rights confirmation: NFT records ownership; metadata stored on IPFS; transaction history is public; smart contracts manage transfers; prevents double-spending; cross-platform interoperability standards.
A0152.limitation: Dependent on blockchain availability; cross-chain assets are complex; centralized platform control still exists. If the private key is leaked or phished, an attacker can forge signatures to bypass on-chain rights confirmation and traceability. Additionally, off-chain metadata storage (such as IPFS) can be tampered with or forged, meaning on-chain records cannot prevent off-chain source falsification.
keywords: On-Chain Asset Ownership Verification and Traceability in the Metaverse
